Conclusions In conclusion, the genetic relationships among Zea species were reported in many previous studies on the basis of morphological, cytogenetical, chemical, and molecular data [4]. The present work provided the first molecular evidence for systematic assessment of genetic relationship of Z. nicaraguensis in Zea species. The results of the analyses using two types of genetic markers, RAPD and ITS, indicate that Z. nicaraguensis has been clearly defined as being the taxon of section Luxuriantes. The Guatemalan teosinte Z. luxurians is the closest relative to the Nicaraguan teosinte Z. nicaraguensis.
